howtos.title: Let an agent pick your model from your own sessions
howtos.what: Have an agent review your past coding sessions and choose which model suits your work best.
copy: Ask an agent (Rauch used Fable) to study your coding sessions.
Have it decide which model is best for you, for example Opus or Gemini Neon.
howtos.whenToUse: When two frontier models look close on public benchmarks and you need to choose one for daily coding.
